sources.name: OS NGD Land Use Features Collection
sources.role: site collection currency, classification and access-location contract
verified_facts: The collection contains Site and Site Access Location feature types with up-to-daily updates.
Sites describe function and access rather than ownership.
semantic_limits: A current site record is not proof of legal extent, complete address linkage or terrain accuracy.

sources.name: OS NGD Site Feature Type
sources.role: recognisable functional extent and schema-version contract
verified_facts: Site is a polygon representing a recognisable extent of a function or activity.
The feature type has evolving schema versions and cross references.
semantic_limits: Functional extent can differ from legal ownership and must not be used as the canonical parcel mask.

sources.name: OS NGD Site Access Location
sources.role: site access point, network-node and distance contract
verified_facts: The feature is a point for pedestrian or vehicle access to a site.
It can reference an accessed network node and straight-line distance.
semantic_limits: Network distance and access location are routing attributes, not terrain height or parcel extent.

sources.name: Site Access Location Description Code List
verified_facts: The code list is associated with the Site Access Location Description attribute.
It constrains access-point labels.
semantic_limits: A label does not prove access legality, cadastral containment or elevation.

sources.name: OS NGD Named Features Collection
sources.role: named feature identity and indicative extent contract
verified_facts: The collection provides named features and can include automatically derived indicative polygon extents for named landforms.
Named feature types separate points and derived extents.
semantic_limits: An indicative named extent is not a surveyed parcel, legal boundary or terrain raster.

sources.name: OS NGD Named Point Feature Type
sources.role: named point, temporal-filtering and identifier contract
verified_facts: Named Point represents named geographic entities as points and has temporal-filtering rules.
It carries OS NGD identity and attribution.
semantic_limits: A named point is not an exact feature extent or elevation extremum.

sources.name: OS NGD Data Structure Information
verified_facts: OS NGD is organised into themes, collections, feature types and features.
Feature types are the granular grouping by geometry or classification.
semantic_limits: Data hierarchy and discoverability do not prove source-byte completeness or measurement validity.

sources.name: OS NGD API Features Availability
sources.role: feature API availability and collection membership contract
verified_facts: The page lists themes, collections and feature types available through the Features API.
Availability differs by feature type and service.
semantic_limits: Advertised availability is not a successful candidate query, complete pagination receipt or data-quality proof.

sources.name: OS NGD API Tiles Availability
sources.role: tile API availability and update-cadence contract
verified_facts: The page lists feature types available through the Tiles API.
Tile publication cadence can differ from underlying collection currency.
semantic_limits: A rendered tile is a portrayal and must not replace source feature geometry or DEM values.

sources.name: OS NGD Current Known Data Issues
sources.role: known-issue disclosure and null/coverage limitation contract
verified_facts: The page publishes known data issues affecting specified themes and attributes.
Known issues can include nullified or incomplete attribution.
semantic_limits: Absence from the known-issues list is not proof that a candidate feature or runtime request is error-free.
